svg.text: 项目建议书承诺与最终系统对齐

text.font-family: "Noto Sans CJK SC", "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "DejaVu Sans", Arial, sans-serif
text.tspan: 早期计划书提出完整行动闭环和金融基本面研究目标，并要求系统结合工具检索与分层记忆以及工程评估。

text.font-family: "Noto Sans CJK SC", "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "DejaVu Sans", Arial, sans-serif
"Noto Sans CJK SC", "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "DejaVu Sans", Arial, sans-serif
text.tspan: v4 单智能体循环支持工具调用，并把观察结果用于核验和最终答案。

text.font-family: "Noto Sans CJK SC", "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "DejaVu Sans", Arial, sans-serif
"Noto Sans CJK SC", "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "DejaVu Sans", Arial, sans-serif
text.tspan: 以 FinanceBench 公开财报问答作为主要高压验证场景。

text.font-family: "Noto Sans CJK SC", "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "DejaVu Sans", Arial, sans-serif
"Noto Sans CJK SC", "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "DejaVu Sans", Arial, sans-serif
text.tspan: 用户输入和公开文件进入系统，SEC/EDGAR 结果与历史运行记录也参与推理。

text.font-family: "Noto Sans CJK SC", "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "DejaVu Sans", Arial, sans-serif
"Noto Sans CJK SC", "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "DejaVu Sans", Arial, sans-serif
text.tspan: 系统参考 LangGraph 和 Hermes 的成熟框架思想，并重写工具调用生命周期。

text.font-family: "Noto Sans CJK SC", "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "DejaVu Sans", Arial, sans-serif
"Noto Sans CJK SC", "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", "DejaVu Sans", Arial, sans-serif
text.tspan: 实验记录通过率和循环轮数，并跟踪工具调用与 token 用量，同时保留缓存命中率和成本以及失败类型。
